title: Dashboard cross-tab (`pivot` with >=2 dimensions) did not get #5827 row hover, and its sort story is unsettled
body:
Noticed while implementing #5827 (PR #5834), which was scoped to the FLAT dataset table only. Filed as an observation, not a defect report — nobody has asked for it.

`packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DatasetWidget.tsx` has two table renderers inside `if (isTable)`:

- the **flat grouped table** (`type: 'table'`, or a `pivot` with one dimension) — #5827 gave it right-aligned numeric columns, sortable headers, blank-bucket-last ordering, and row hover;
- the **cross-tab** (`type: 'pivot'` with >=2 dimensions, `data-testid="dataset-matrix"`) — untouched by that card.

The cross-tab already right-aligns its measure cells, so the worst of #5827 does not apply. What it still lacks, measured by reading the branch:

1. **No row hover.** Its `<tr>` carries only `border-t`; hover exists on individual drillable *cells* (`hover:bg-accent/40` on `dataset-drill-cell`), never on the row. On a wide cross-tab, tracking a row across bucket columns is exactly where a row highlight earns its place.
2. **`tabular-nums` on the row-header cells.** `<td className="px-2 py-1 whitespace-nowrap font-medium">` for row-dimension labels — actually these do NOT carry it, unlike the flat table's cells; noting it here only so a future sweep does not "fix" it by adding one.
3. **No sortable headers.** A cross-tab's axes are structural (row buckets down, column buckets across), so "click a header to sort" is not the same feature it is on a flat table — sorting rows by one across-bucket's measure is a real feature, but it is a design question, not a port of #5827's implementation.

Item 3 is the one that needs a ruling before any code: whether a cross-tab should sort its row axis by a chosen cell column at all. Items 1 is mechanical.

Not blocking anything. Filed unassigned.
